pr_title: kvserver: add option to skip merge queue if external files are present
pr_body:
Replicas with external files are expensive to iterate. Further, they have very in-accurate stats. Here we add an option to skip the merge queue if a replica happens to have external files.

Fixes #120256

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/120541)

@nvanbenschoten @miraradeva I believe in our recent discussion y'all indicated that something like this were we completely exclude some replica's from a queue would be a bit more tenable. Here we exclude replicas with external bytes from the merge queue.

issue_context.title: online restore,kv: exempt ranges with external files from merge queue
issue_context.body:
When ranges are online restored, they are populated with pointers to external data and estimated stats, what might not be accurate. We don't want to spend any of our limited bandwidth until the restore is done on accessing the data to compute more correct stats and would rather just use the estimates until it is restored and we can compute stats on the restored data, however this means we need to be defensive about what could go "wrong" making decisions based on estimated stats. One particularly bad "wrong" decision would be to merge two ranges. As the merged range downloads it would then overfill and require being split again, wasting valuable resources we could have spent on restoring. Additionally it too many ranges were incorrectly merged we'd lose some of the distribution that is vital in maintaining even and maximal utilization during the restore. We should probably just disable all merges on ranges that contain external data, or external data and estimated stats, skipping over them in the merge queue. 

Jira issue: CRDB-36567
